grammar.title: Being unhappy about something with 不满
grammar.explanation: 不满 (bùmǎn) means "dissatisfied, discontented" often used with 对 to specify what someone is unhappy about: 对这个结果不满.

grammar.title: Summing up with 一共
grammar.explanation: 一共 (yígòng) means "in total, altogether" used to sum up a quantity, often with 多少 in questions: 一共多少钱? (how much in total?).

sentences.en: How much is it in total?
There are ten of us in total.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng sānbǎi yè.
sentences.en: This book has three hundred pages in total.

sentences.pinyin: Tā yígòng qù guo wǔ gè guójiā.
sentences.en: He's been to five countries in total.

sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhège jiéguǒ hěn bùmǎn.
sentences.en: He's very dissatisfied with this result.
I'm not satisfied with this method.
